citations.quote: Survival is not created in panic. It's created in usefulness. So instead of asking myself what if everything falls apart, ask yourself, what problem can I solve today that somebody would actually pay for? Because in uncertain times useful people survive faster than emotional people.

observation.text: Olgasi presents survival strategy by contrasting the outcomes of being useful versus emotional.
